purpose: Replacement pool of consumer Outlook operational guides for the 100-page first wave.
author: Claude (claude-opus-5-5), logged-in subscription session; no API keys, no paid calls
lessonsAppliedFromReviews01and02: Scope each claim to the exact client tab and account type Microsoft names; label undocumented clients as undocumented.
Scope warnings to the specific action that carries the risk, not to a whole procedure.
Do not turn 'the page does not say' into a negative claim; say it is not documented.
Use exact UI labels as returned; flag WebFetch-extracted text for re-verification.
Worked examples state their assumed settings and avoid immediate-result promises.

briefs.distinctTask: Keep declined meetings visible in new Outlook (work/school), and recover a meeting you declined in classic Outlook.
briefs.boundary: Attendee's own calendar display of declined items; RSVP counting stays on the existing page.

briefs.distinctTask: Build buffer time by having Outlook end events early or start them late, per account, without assuming it rewrites existing meetings.
briefs.boundary: Outlook shorten-duration setting only; Google appointment buffers are separate.

briefs.distinctTask: Turn an email thread into a meeting request with the right attendees and content, and know when the option fails.
briefs.boundary: Manual email-to-meeting in Outlook; automatic reservation events are a separate brief.

briefs.distinctTask: Understand why flights, hotels, car rentals and parcels appear on an Outlook calendar, and change per-type display or privacy.
briefs.boundary: Outlook.com / Microsoft-account Events from email; Google's Gmail-events is Claude batch 02.

briefs.distinctTask: Restore a deleted Outlook appointment or meeting from Deleted Items, then from the server's recoverable items, per client.
briefs.boundary: Outlook new/classic only; existing page covers Google and iCloud. No retention period is stated because Microsoft's fetched pages give none.

briefs.distinctTask: Colour-code Outlook calendar items with categories, knowing they are personal and don't change attendees' views.
briefs.boundary: Outlook categories; calendar-level colours and Cloud Calendars colours stay on the existing page.
